subtitle: One profile shape, one set of credentials per developer

code:
jaffle_shop:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: snowflake
      account: "{{ env_var('SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT') }}"
      role: transformer
      schema: dev
    prod:
      type: snowflake
      role: transformer
      schema: prod
caption: Two targets, same shape, pointing at different schemas.

eyebrow: Why target: dev is the default

caption: Checks account, user, role, warehouse, and database all resolve.
